Albania.capitalCity: Tirana — a city painted in all the colors of the rainbow! 🌈
Albania.locationAndSize: A small magical country by the sparkling blue sea in Europe
Albania.language: Albanian — a very ancient and mysterious language
Albania.cultureAndTraditions: People here sing together in big groups — their voices sound like a beautiful spell! They also make amazing colorful costumes
Albania.natureAndWildlife: Home to mighty eagles, fluffy bears, and crystal-clear mountain lakes where fairies might be hiding
Albania.friendlyPeople: Albanian people have a special rule called 'Besa' — once they promise to be your friend, they will protect you forever!

videos.title: Albania for kids

Andorra.capitalCity: Andorra la Vella — a tiny city sitting high up in the snowy mountains ⛄
Andorra.locationAndSize: A teeny-tiny country hidden between two big mountains — smaller than many cities!
Andorra.language: Catalan — a lovely sounding language full of musical words
Andorra.cultureAndTraditions: Every winter the mountains turn white and children go sledding and skiing all day long!
Andorra.natureAndWildlife: Cute little animals called chamois jump between the rocks, and huge eagles soar over snowy peaks
Andorra.friendlyPeople: Everyone in Andorra knows each other — it's like one big friendly village in the sky!

videos.title: Andorra mountain adventure

Austria.capitalCity: Vienna — a grand city full of palaces, music, and the yummiest cakes! 🎂
Austria.locationAndSize: A beautiful country in the heart of Europe surrounded by the magical Alps mountains
Austria.language: German — the same language as in fairy tales by the Brothers Grimm!
Austria.cultureAndTraditions: Mozart was born here and wrote music so beautiful it sounds like angels singing. There are also magical Christmas markets with twinkling lights!
Austria.natureAndWildlife: White Lipizzaner horses that dance like ballerinas, chamois that leap on steep cliffs, and friendly deer in the forests
Austria.friendlyPeople: Austrian people love to sit in cozy cafés and drink hot chocolate while snowflakes fall outside — just like in a fairy tale!

photos.caption: Hallstatt — the most fairy tale village in the world

videos.title: Austria — fairy tale country

Belarus.capitalCity: Minsk — a big, clean city with wide streets and beautiful parks 🌳
Belarus.locationAndSize: A country of deep magical forests and hundreds of sparkling lakes in Eastern Europe
Belarus.language: Belarusian — soft and gentle, like a lullaby
Belarus.cultureAndTraditions: At midsummer people float flower wreaths on rivers and jump over bonfires to make their wishes come true!
Belarus.natureAndWildlife: The last magical ancient forest in Europe lives here — with real European bison, giant fluffy animals like walking mountains!
Belarus.friendlyPeople: Belarusian grandmothers make the most delicious dumplings called draniki — potato pancakes that disappear from the plate instantly!

photos.caption: European bison in the ancient forest

videos.title: Belarus — land of bison and forests

Belgium.capitalCity: Brussels — where the Smurfs and Tintin were born! 🍄
Belgium.locationAndSize: A small but super delicious country in Western Europe
Belgium.language: People speak Dutch, French, AND German — they are amazing at languages!
Belgium.cultureAndTraditions: Belgium invented the Smurfs, Tintin, and the best chocolate in the whole world! Also amazing waffles with strawberries and cream 🧇
Belgium.natureAndWildlife: Wild boars roam the Ardennes forest, and you can spot kingfishers — tiny birds that shine like flying jewels by rivers
Belgium.friendlyPeople: Belgian children eat chocolate for breakfast, lunch, and dessert — and nobody thinks that is strange at all!

videos.title: Belgium — chocolate and Smurfs!

Bosnia and Herzegovina.capitalCity: Sarajevo — a city where East and West meet like two best friends 🤝
Bosnia and Herzegovina.locationAndSize: A mountainous country in Southeast Europe with rushing rivers and waterfalls
Bosnia and Herzegovina.language: Bosnian — warm and musical, great for telling stories
Bosnia and Herzegovina.cultureAndTraditions: There is a famous old bridge called Stari Most that brave divers jump from into the sparkling river below!
Bosnia and Herzegovina.natureAndWildlife: Huge bears, wolves, and colorful fish swim in the crystal-clear emerald rivers between the mountains
Bosnia and Herzegovina.friendlyPeople: In Sarajevo three different religions live side by side in peace — mosque, church, and synagogue are all neighbors!

photos.caption: Stari Most bridge over the Neretva river

videos.title: Bosnia — bridges and waterfalls

Bulgaria.capitalCity: Sofia — a city where ancient history hides around every corner 🏛️
Bulgaria.locationAndSize: A wonderful country in Southeast Europe with mountains, beaches, and rose fields
Bulgaria.language: Bulgarian — written in the Cyrillic alphabet, invented right here!
Bulgaria.cultureAndTraditions: Every spring whole valleys turn pink and purple with millions of roses — people collect them to make magical rose perfume! Also scary Kukeri monsters dance to chase away bad spirits 👹
Bulgaria.natureAndWildlife: Bulgaria has big fluffy bears, howling wolves, and white pelicans that fly over the lakes like beautiful clouds
Bulgaria.friendlyPeople: Careful — Bulgarian people nod their head for NO and shake it for YES, the opposite of everyone else! Very confusing and very funny 😄

videos.title: Bulgaria — roses and monsters

Croatia.capitalCity: Zagreb — a cozy city with a Christmas market that won best in Europe! 🎄
Croatia.locationAndSize: A beautiful country with 1,246 islands in the sparkling blue Adriatic Sea
Croatia.language: Croatian — sounds like music when spoken by the sea
Croatia.cultureAndTraditions: Did you know the necktie was invented in Croatia? And there are magical waterfalls at Plitvice that glow in turquoise and green!
Croatia.natureAndWildlife: So many islands! Some have only goats, rabbits, or donkeys living on them. Lynx prowl the forests and dolphins play in the sea
Croatia.friendlyPeople: Croatian kids swim in the sea from April to October — the water is so clear you can count every pebble on the bottom!

photos.caption: Dubrovnik old city by the sea

videos.title: Croatia — islands and waterfalls

Cyprus.capitalCity: Nicosia — the last divided capital city in the world 🌍
Cyprus.locationAndSize: A sunny island in the warm Mediterranean Sea — birthplace of Aphrodite, the goddess of love!
Cyprus.language: Greek and Turkish — two languages on one little island
Cyprus.cultureAndTraditions: According to legend, the goddess of love Aphrodite was born from sea foam right here! People also make delicious halloumi cheese that squeaks when you eat it 🧀
Cyprus.natureAndWildlife: Adorable mouflon sheep with curly horns live in the mountains, and sea turtles lay their eggs on the beaches at night
Cyprus.friendlyPeople: On Cyprus every stranger is treated like a long-lost friend — they will immediately offer you coffee and homemade sweets!

photos.caption: Aphrodite's Rock rising from the sea
Baby sea turtles going to the sea

videos.title: Cyprus — island of the love goddess

Czech Republic.capitalCity: Prague — a fairy tale city with a real magical clock! ⚙️🕐
Czech Republic.locationAndSize: A magical country in the heart of Europe, surrounded by gentle mountains
Czech Republic.language: Czech — a Slavic language with lots of fun sounds
Czech Republic.cultureAndTraditions: Prague has an amazing clock from 1410 that puts on a little show every hour — skeletons, apostles, and a crowing rooster! Also Czech people drink more juice made from hops than anyone else in the world
Czech Republic.natureAndWildlife: Wolves and lynx have come back to the Czech forests, and there are amazing crystal-clear caves with underground rivers
Czech Republic.friendlyPeople: Czech people love fairy tales — their country looks just like the setting of a storybook with castles on every hill!

videos.title: Prague — city of a thousand fairy tales

Denmark.capitalCity: Copenhagen — the happiest city in the world, home of LEGO! 🧱
Denmark.locationAndSize: A cozy kingdom in Northern Europe, plus Greenland and the Faroe Islands
Denmark.language: Danish — a funny language where some letters are almost silent
Denmark.cultureAndTraditions: Hans Christian Andersen wrote The Little Mermaid, Thumbelina, and The Ugly Duckling here! LEGO was also invented in Denmark — the name means 'play well'!
Denmark.natureAndWildlife: Thousands of starlings fly in giant shapes called 'Black Sun' — it looks like a living, breathing cloud in the sky!
Denmark.friendlyPeople: Danish people invented 'hygge' — cozy evenings with candles, hot cocoa, warm blankets, and your best friends 🕯️

videos.title: Denmark — LEGO and fairy tales

Estonia.capitalCity: Tallinn — a medieval fairy tale city with towers and city walls 🏰
Estonia.locationAndSize: A small, smart country in Northern Europe next to the Baltic Sea
Estonia.language: Estonian — one of the oldest and most unique languages in Europe
Estonia.cultureAndTraditions: Every few years ALL Estonians — thousands and thousands of people — gather to sing together in a giant Song Festival. Imagine a choir of 25,000 voices! 🎵
Estonia.natureAndWildlife: Estonia has magical bogs — spongy mossy lands like walking on a trampoline! Bears, lynx, and flying squirrels live in the ancient forests
Estonia.friendlyPeople: Estonians invented Skype so children all over the world can video-call their grandparents — what a wonderful gift to the world!

videos.title: Estonia — medieval towers and singing forests

Finland.capitalCity: Helsinki — a bright city on the sea where design and nature meet 🌊
Finland.locationAndSize: A magical northern country with 188,000 lakes — that is more lakes than anywhere else in the world!
Finland.language: Finnish — so different from other languages it sounds like an elf speaking!
Finland.cultureAndTraditions: SANTA CLAUS LIVES IN FINLAND — in Lapland in the north! 🎅 Finnish people also love saunas — even babies go to sauna, and there are more saunas than cars!
Finland.natureAndWildlife: Reindeer walk through the streets in Lapland! Also brown bears, wolverines, lynx, and the most amazing Northern Lights dancing in green and purple
Finland.friendlyPeople: Finnish children go to school even when it is minus 20 degrees outside — they say there is no bad weather, only wrong clothes! 🧥

videos.title: Finland — Santa's homeland

France.capitalCity: Paris — the city of the Eiffel Tower, croissants, and adventure! 🗼
France.locationAndSize: A big beautiful country in Western Europe — the largest in the EU!
France.language: French — the language of love and delicious food
France.cultureAndTraditions: France has the most famous art museum in the world — the Louvre, where the Mona Lisa smiles mysteriously! Also croissants, macarons, and the most delicious cheese you can imagine 🥐
France.natureAndWildlife: Wild white horses called Camargue horses run free through marshes, and chamois leap in the snowy Alps
France.friendlyPeople: French people greet each other with two kisses on the cheek — even children do this when they meet friends!

photos.caption: Lavender fields purple as far as you can see

videos.title: France — croissants, castles, and the Eiffel Tower

Germany.capitalCity: Berlin — a big creative city full of art, music, and amazing playgrounds 🎨
Germany.locationAndSize: A large country in the heart of Europe — home of fairy tales and cars!
Germany.language: German — strong and powerful, like the language of storybook kings
Germany.cultureAndTraditions: The Brothers Grimm collected fairy tales here — Cinderella, Snow White, Hansel and Gretel are all German! There are also magical Christmas markets with gingerbread and hot cocoa 🎄
Germany.natureAndWildlife: The Black Forest is a real dark mysterious forest where fairy tales happen! Wolves have returned to roam, and lynx hide between the trees
Germany.friendlyPeople: Germany has over 3,000 different kinds of bread — and Germans think bread is the most important food in the world!

photos.caption: Neuschwanstein — the real fairy tale castle

videos.title: Germany — where fairy tales were born

Greece.capitalCity: Athens — the city where the Olympic Games were invented! 🏛️🏅
Greece.locationAndSize: A sunny country with over 6,000 islands in the warm blue Mediterranean Sea
Greece.language: Greek — one of the oldest languages in the world, 3,500 years old!
Greece.cultureAndTraditions: Zeus, Athena, Poseidon, Hercules — all the greatest gods and heroes were Greek! The Olympics started here too. And Greek food is so good — pita bread, honey, feta cheese 🍯
Greece.natureAndWildlife: Loggerhead sea turtles lay eggs on the beaches, fluffy monk seals swim in sea caves, and pelicans walk around like they own the place
Greece.friendlyPeople: Greek people believe that every stranger might secretly be a god in disguise — so they welcome everyone with a feast!

photos.caption: Santorini blue domes above the sea

videos.title: Greece — gods, heroes, and blue seas

Hungary.capitalCity: Budapest — a royal city split by the Danube River into two halves! 👑
Hungary.locationAndSize: A beautiful country in Central Europe surrounded by mountains on all sides
Hungary.language: Hungarian — so unique it is unlike any other language in Europe!
Hungary.cultureAndTraditions: Budapest has 118 hot water springs! Children and grown-ups swim in huge beautiful bath palaces — even in winter when it snows! 🏊 Also Hungarians invented the Rubik's Cube — the most famous puzzle toy ever!
Hungary.natureAndWildlife: On the great Hungarian plain (puszta) giant fluffy grey cattle and beautiful wild horses roam freely like they did a thousand years ago
Hungary.friendlyPeople: Hungarian grandmothers make a spicy red powder called paprika go into EVERYTHING — even the soup, the meat, and the vegetables!

photos.caption: Budapest castle and river at night

videos.title: Hungary — hot baths and the Rubik's Cube!

Iceland.capitalCity: Reykjavik — the northernmost capital city in the whole world! ❄️
Iceland.locationAndSize: A magical island near the North Pole with volcanoes, geysers, and glaciers
Iceland.language: Icelandic — almost the same language Vikings spoke 1,000 years ago!
Iceland.cultureAndTraditions: Iceland has elves! More than half of all Icelandic people believe in hidden elves called Huldufólk who live in rocks — roads are even built around their magical stones! 🧝
Iceland.natureAndWildlife: Geysers shoot hot water 30 meters high! Cute puffin birds with rainbow beaks live on the cliffs, and Northern Lights dance like green fire in the sky
Iceland.friendlyPeople: Iceland has no army and barely any crime — it is one of the safest and most peaceful places on Earth for children!

photos.caption: Geyser shooting water into the sky

videos.title: Iceland — elves geysers and Northern Lights

Ireland.capitalCity: Dublin — a lively city full of music, stories, and green parks ☘️
Ireland.locationAndSize: A beautiful green island in the Atlantic Ocean — so green it is called the Emerald Isle!
Ireland.language: English and Irish — Irish is one of the oldest languages in Europe
Ireland.cultureAndTraditions: Ireland is the homeland of leprechauns — tiny magical shoemakers who hide pots of gold at the end of rainbows! 🌈 St. Patrick's Day makes rivers and even beer green!
Ireland.natureAndWildlife: Huge dramatic cliffs called the Cliffs of Moher drop straight into the roaring Atlantic. Puffins, grey seals, and red deer live here
Ireland.friendlyPeople: Irish people are the best storytellers in the world — every evening becomes a magical adventure of songs and tales in a cozy pub!

photos.caption: Cliffs of Moher — tall as 8 houses!

videos.title: Ireland — leprechauns and green hills

Italy.capitalCity: Rome — the eternal city where gladiators once fought in the Colosseum! ⚔️
Italy.locationAndSize: A boot-shaped country in Southern Europe sticking out into the warm Mediterranean Sea
Italy.language: Italian — the most musical language, like singing every word!
Italy.cultureAndTraditions: Pizza, pasta, gelato — Italy gave the world its best foods! 🍕🍦 Venice is a city with canals instead of streets where people travel by boat! Pinocchio is Italian too!
Italy.natureAndWildlife: Real wolves roam the forests, brown bears live in the mountains, and in Sardinia flamingos turn the lakes pink
Italy.friendlyPeople: Italian grandmothers (nonnas) cook the most delicious food in the world, and feeding people is how Italians say 'I love you'!

videos.title: Italy — pizza, gondolas, and ancient heroes

Kosovo.capitalCity: Pristina — Europe's youngest and most energetic capital city 🌟
Kosovo.locationAndSize: A small young country in Southeast Europe — one of the newest countries in the world!
Kosovo.language: Albanian and Serbian — two languages for one little nation
Kosovo.cultureAndTraditions: Kosovo has the youngest population in Europe — lots of children, playgrounds, and energy everywhere! Amazing street art decorates the city like a giant outdoor museum
Kosovo.natureAndWildlife: Deep canyons, rushing rivers, golden eagles soaring overhead, and brown bears in the mountain forests
Kosovo.friendlyPeople: Kosovo people are the most welcoming in the Balkans — they are so happy when visitors come to see their beautiful country!

videos.title: Kosovo — young country big heart

Latvia.capitalCity: Riga — a beautiful city with amazing fairy tale buildings! 🏙️
Latvia.locationAndSize: A small foresty country by the Baltic Sea in Northern Europe
Latvia.language: Latvian — one of the oldest living languages in Europe
Latvia.cultureAndTraditions: At midsummer children make flower crowns and celebrate through the entire night when it barely gets dark! 🌸 Latvia is also the land of amber — golden orange ancient tree resin with insects frozen inside for millions of years!
Latvia.natureAndWildlife: Ancient oak forests, sandy dunes by the sea, fluffy grey seals, and white-tailed eagles with huge wingspans
Latvia.friendlyPeople: Latvians are very connected to nature — they know the names of all the forest berries and mushrooms and love picking them together!

videos.title: Latvia — amber forests and flower crowns

Liechtenstein.capitalCity: Vaduz — a tiny capital where the Prince's castle watches over everything 🏰
Liechtenstein.locationAndSize: A teeny-tiny country between two mountains — so small you can walk across it in one day!
Liechtenstein.language: German — same as Austria and Switzerland next door
Liechtenstein.cultureAndTraditions: The Prince lives in a real castle on the hill above town! Every National Day he invites ALL the citizens to a garden party — imagine being invited to a prince's party! 🎉
Liechtenstein.natureAndWildlife: Fluffy marmots whistle alarm signals in the mountain meadows, chamois leap across cliffs, and the Prince has beautiful vineyards
Liechtenstein.friendlyPeople: With only 38,000 people, Liechtenstein is like one big family — everyone knows the prince, the baker, and the schoolteacher!

photos.caption: Vaduz castle on the green hill

videos.title: Liechtenstein — the tiny fairy tale kingdom

Lithuania.capitalCity: Vilnius — a city full of baroque churches and magical hidden courtyards ✨
Lithuania.locationAndSize: A green country by the Baltic Sea with ancient forests and amber beaches
Lithuania.language: Lithuanian — the oldest living language in Europe, close to ancient Sanskrit!
Lithuania.cultureAndTraditions: Lithuania was one of the last countries in Europe to have its own pagan gods and forest spirits! People still celebrate ancient nature festivals. And there is a magical hill covered in thousands and thousands of crosses 🕌
Lithuania.natureAndWildlife: Golden sand dunes right next to the sea, storks nesting on every rooftop, grey wolves, and magnificent elk
Lithuania.friendlyPeople: Lithuanian people love singing folk songs that tell stories of the forest, the sea, and love — music runs in their blood!

photos.caption: Curonian Spit sand dunes and sea
Hill of Crosses — thousands of crosses

videos.title: Lithuania — ancient magic by the sea

Luxembourg.capitalCity: Luxembourg City — a city built on dramatic rocky cliffs with old fortresses! 🏔️
Luxembourg.locationAndSize: A small but very grand country in Western Europe — home of one of the most impressive castles
Luxembourg.language: People here speak THREE languages — Luxembourgish, French, and German!
Luxembourg.cultureAndTraditions: Every year there is a magical dancing procession where thousands of people hop through the streets together — even the elderly and children dance! 💃
Luxembourg.natureAndWildlife: Red kites — beautiful fork-tailed birds — soar over the valleys, otters play in clear rivers, and the Ardennes forest is full of deer
Luxembourg.friendlyPeople: Children in Luxembourg grow up speaking three languages before they are ten years old — that makes them super smart!

videos.title: Luxembourg — tiny grand duchy

Malta.capitalCity: Valletta — one of the smallest capital cities in the world, golden and magical! ✨
Malta.locationAndSize: A tiny island in the warm blue Mediterranean Sea — just three small islands!
Malta.language: Maltese — the only Semitic language written in Latin letters, and English too
Malta.cultureAndTraditions: Every village has its own festival called a 'festa' with the most spectacular fireworks you have ever seen — whole families stay up until midnight for the show! 🎆 Also Malta has temples older than the pyramids of Egypt!
Malta.natureAndWildlife: The sea around Malta is crystal clear and warm — you can see fish, octopus, and sea turtles while snorkeling
Malta.friendlyPeople: Maltese people are so proud of their fireworks that every village tries to make bigger and better ones than their neighbors — a friendly competition!

videos.title: Malta — tiny island with ancient temples

Moldova.capitalCity: Chișinău — a green city with lots of parks and fruit trees 🍇
Moldova.locationAndSize: A small country in Eastern Europe surrounded by Ukraine and Romania
Moldova.language: Romanian (Moldovan) — a beautiful language that sounds like Italian
Moldova.cultureAndTraditions: Moldova has the most amazing wine caves in the world! Underground tunnels stretch for 120 kilometers — you can drive a car through them! 🍷 There is even a whole underground city with streets named after wines!
Moldova.natureAndWildlife: White storks build giant nests on every rooftop in the villages — families of storks are considered lucky charms!
Moldova.friendlyPeople: In Moldovan villages every family makes their own wine, jam, and pickles — visiting means going home with a bag full of homemade treasures!

photos.caption: Stork nest on a village roof

videos.title: Moldova — secret wine caves

Monaco.capitalCity: Monaco — the glittering city of racing cars and princes! 🏎️👑
Monaco.locationAndSize: The second tiniest country in the world — smaller than Central Park in New York!
Monaco.language: French — but with lots of international friends from all over the world
Monaco.cultureAndTraditions: Once a year Formula 1 racing cars zoom through the streets of Monaco at incredible speed — right past buildings, shops, and the harbor! 🏁 There is also a real Prince in a palace!
Monaco.natureAndWildlife: The Oceanographic Museum has an amazing aquarium with hundreds of sea creatures — Jacques Cousteau used to run it!
Monaco.friendlyPeople: Monaco is so tiny you can walk from one end to the other in 20 minutes — and maybe see the Prince along the way!

videos.title: Monaco — tiny country of big races

Montenegro.capitalCity: Podgorica — surrounded by rivers and mountains on all sides 🏔️
Montenegro.locationAndSize: A small wild country in Southeast Europe — the name means 'Black Mountain'!
Montenegro.language: Montenegrin — warm and melodic, perfect for epic poetry
Montenegro.cultureAndTraditions: Montenegro has the deepest canyon in Europe — the Tara Canyon is so deep that if you dropped a ball from the top it would take a long time to reach the river! 🏞️
Montenegro.natureAndWildlife: Bears and wolves roam the mountains, Griffon vultures with giant wings soar overhead, and the canyon river is one of the cleanest in the world
Montenegro.friendlyPeople: Montenegrins are famous for having the best sense of humor in the Balkans — they laugh about everything, especially themselves!

photos.caption: Bay of Kotor — fjord surrounded by mountains

videos.title: Montenegro — black mountain adventures

Netherlands.capitalCity: Amsterdam — a city of canals, bicycles, and tulips! 🌷🚲
Netherlands.locationAndSize: A flat country in Western Europe — so flat that a quarter of it is actually below the sea!
Netherlands.language: Dutch — sounds a little bit like German and English mixed together
Netherlands.cultureAndTraditions: The Dutch built giant windmills to pump water out of the sea! 🌬️ LEGO-like toy brick houses stand in a row by the canals. Every spring the whole country turns into a carpet of red, yellow, and pink tulips!
Netherlands.natureAndWildlife: Wild horses roam freely in nature reserves, and every spring millions of birds stop here during their migration — like a bird airport!
Netherlands.friendlyPeople: Dutch children have their own bicycle lane separate from cars — they learn to ride bikes before they can read!

videos.title: Netherlands — windmills, tulips, and bikes

North Macedonia.capitalCity: Skopje — a city that rebuilt itself and added hundreds of statues everywhere! 🗿
North Macedonia.locationAndSize: A small landlocked country in Southeast Europe surrounded by beautiful mountains
North Macedonia.cultureAndTraditions: Lake Ohrid is one of the oldest lakes in the world — 3 million years old! It has 200 kinds of animals that live NOWHERE ELSE on Earth — like a real-life Jurassic Park but with fish! 🐟
North Macedonia.natureAndWildlife: Brown bears, lynx, and Balkan chamois live in the mountains, while the ancient lake has glowing trout and endemic snails
North Macedonia.friendlyPeople: Every August there is a giant wedding festival in a mountain village where hundreds of couples get married at the same time — a huge joyful celebration!

videos.title: North Macedonia — ancient lake treasures

Norway.capitalCity: Oslo — a city where the forest begins right at the edge of town! 🌲
Norway.locationAndSize: A long stretched country in Northern Europe with the most beautiful fjords in the world
Norway.language: Norwegian — two versions of the language exist because the country has two official written forms!
Norway.cultureAndTraditions: Vikings came from Norway and sailed to discover America long before Columbus! 🛶 In the far north the sun never sets in summer — children play outside at midnight!
Norway.natureAndWildlife: Polar bears live in Svalbard islands in the Arctic! Reindeer pull sleds in the north, orca whales swim along the coast, and the Northern Lights paint the sky
Norway.friendlyPeople: Norwegian children go to school even in minus 20 degrees weather — they love being outside in snow and go skiing from age 2!

videos.title: Norway — Vikings, fjords, and Aurora

Poland.capitalCity: Warsaw — a brave city that was destroyed and beautifully rebuilt! 🏙️
Poland.locationAndSize: A large country in Central Europe — one of the biggest in Europe!
Poland.language: Polish — has letters with special marks above them like ą, ę, ż, ó!
Poland.cultureAndTraditions: Poland has a dragon legend! Long ago a terrible dragon lived under Wawel Castle in Kraków — until a clever shoemaker tricked it. The dragon statue still breathes real fire today! 🐉🔥
Poland.natureAndWildlife: The ancient Białowieża forest is home to huge European bison — the biggest land animals in Europe, heavy as a car! Wolves and lynx hunt in the shadows
Poland.friendlyPeople: Polish grandmothers make pierogies — delicious dumplings filled with potato, cheese, or berries — every Sunday for the whole family!

photos.caption: Wawel dragon breathing fire in Kraków

videos.title: Poland — dragons, bison, and dumplings

Portugal.capitalCity: Lisbon — a hilly city with yellow trams and the smell of the sea! 🚋🌊
Portugal.locationAndSize: A country at the very western edge of Europe — after Portugal there is only the Atlantic Ocean!
Portugal.language: Portuguese — the same language spoken in Brazil, and by 250 million people worldwide!
Portugal.cultureAndTraditions: Portuguese explorers were the bravest sailors in the world — they discovered new continents and sailed around Africa! 🚢 Also custard tarts called pastéis de nata are so delicious the recipe is a secret!
Portugal.natureAndWildlife: The Iberian lynx — the rarest cat in the world — was almost extinct but is coming back in Portugal! And you can watch whales from the shore in the Azores islands!
Portugal.friendlyPeople: Portuguese people feel deep love for the sea — they even have a special word 'saudade' for the bittersweet feeling of missing something beautiful

videos.title: Portugal — explorers and pastéis de nata

Romania.capitalCity: Bucharest — a grand city with a palace so big it is the heaviest building in the world! 🏛️
Romania.locationAndSize: A large country in Southeast Europe with Dracula's mountains and the Danube Delta
Romania.language: Romanian — a Latin language, descended from ancient Roman soldiers stationed here!
Romania.cultureAndTraditions: Count Dracula is from Romania — Bran Castle sits on a cliff just like in the stories! 🧛 Also Romanian monasteries are painted with beautiful colorful pictures on the outside walls like giant storybooks
Romania.natureAndWildlife: Romania has more brown bears than any other country in Europe — 6,000 bears roam the Carpathian mountains! Also wolves, lynx, and the biggest river delta in Europe full of pelicans
Romania.friendlyPeople: Romanian children celebrate spring by giving each other red and white bracelets called mărțișor — a bracelet that brings good luck!

videos.title: Romania — Dracula bears and painted monasteries

San Marino.capitalCity: San Marino City — perched on top of a dramatic rocky mountain! ⛰️
San Marino.locationAndSize: The world's oldest republic — completely surrounded by Italy and smaller than many cities!
San Marino.language: Italian — same as their neighbor Italy all around them
San Marino.cultureAndTraditions: San Marino has three magnificent towers on top of a mountain that look exactly like something from a video game! 🏰 Every year crossbow archers compete in medieval costumes just like in the Middle Ages
San Marino.natureAndWildlife: Peregrine falcons — the fastest animals on Earth — nest in the fortress walls and dive at 320 km/h!
San Marino.friendlyPeople: San Marino has existed for 1,723 years and has NEVER been conquered — a tiny country that has always been free and proud!

photos.caption: Three towers on top of the mountain

videos.title: San Marino — ancient fortress republic

Serbia.capitalCity: Belgrade — one of the oldest continuously lived-in cities in the world! 🏰
Serbia.locationAndSize: A landlocked country in Southeast Europe where two great rivers meet
Serbia.language: Serbian — uses two alphabets, both Cyrillic and Latin!
Serbia.cultureAndTraditions: Nikola Tesla — the genius who invented alternating current electricity and wireless communication — was born in Serbia! ⚡ Also Serbia has the Guča trumpet festival where 300,000 people listen to brass bands for four days straight!
Serbia.natureAndWildlife: The Iron Gates gorge is so deep and dramatic that ancient Romans carved a road into the cliff face — you can still see it! Griffon vultures circle overhead
Serbia.friendlyPeople: Serbian people celebrate their family's patron saint day (Slava) with a big party every year — even better than a birthday!

photos.caption: Iron Gates gorge on the Danube

videos.title: Serbia — Tesla rivers and trumpets

Slovakia.locationAndSize: A small mountainous country in Central Europe — castle capital of Europe!
Slovakia.language: Slovak — so similar to Czech that Slovaks and Czechs understand each other!

Slovakia.natureAndWildlife: Brown bears walk through the forests, lynx creep silently, and the High Tatras mountains are home to chamois and eagles
Slovakia.friendlyPeople: Slovak shepherds have been making the most delicious sheep cheese called bryndza for centuries — it goes into a famous dish called bryndzové halušky (potato dumplings with cheese)!

Slovenia.capitalCity: Ljubljana — a city with a dragon as its symbol and a castle on a hill! 🐉
Slovenia.locationAndSize: A tiny but incredibly beautiful country between the Alps and the Adriatic Sea
Slovenia.language: Slovenian — has so many dialects that people from different valleys sometimes can barely understand each other!
Slovenia.cultureAndTraditions: Lake Bled has a tiny island in the middle with a church — to get there you row a special boat called a pletna! 🚣 The bell on the island grants wishes! Also Slovenia has the most amazing cave — 27 kilometers of underground passages!
Slovenia.natureAndWildlife: The Soča River is the most beautiful emerald-green color, like liquid jade. Brown bears, wolves, and lynx all live in the forests
Slovenia.friendlyPeople: Slovenia is the greenest country in Europe — Slovenians love nature so much they have protected almost half their entire country as natural parks!

Spain.capitalCity: Madrid — a sunny city that never sleeps, full of art and football! ⚽☀️
Spain.locationAndSize: A large sunny country in Southwest Europe — second biggest in the EU
Spain.language: Spanish — the second most spoken language in the world!
Spain.cultureAndTraditions: In Spain there is a festival where people throw millions of tomatoes at each other — La Tomatina! 🍅 Also Gaudí built a church in Barcelona that looks like it grew from the ground like a giant sandcastle! Flamenco dancers stomp so loud the floor shakes!
Spain.natureAndWildlife: The Iberian lynx was almost gone but is making a comeback! Spanish imperial eagles soar over cork oak forests, and Doñana park is a paradise for flamingos
Spain.friendlyPeople: Spanish children eat dinner at 10 o'clock at night with the whole family — staying up late is completely normal and wonderful!

Sweden.capitalCity: Stockholm — a city built on 14 islands connected by 57 bridges! 🌉
Sweden.locationAndSize: A long country in Northern Scandinavia — where ABBA, IKEA, and Minecraft were born!
Sweden.language: Swedish — melodic and flowing, like a gentle river
Sweden.cultureAndTraditions: Midsummer is the most magical celebration — people make flower crowns, dance around a maypole, and it stays light ALL NIGHT! 🌸 Also Sweden gave the world ABBA music, IKEA furniture, and Minecraft — three incredible gifts!
Sweden.natureAndWildlife: Sweden has over 300,000 moose — so many that some wander into cities! Also wolves, lynx, wolverines, and the most spectacular Northern Lights
Sweden.friendlyPeople: Swedish children have a wonderful tradition called 'fika' — a daily break for hot cocoa and a cinnamon bun with friends 🥐

Switzerland.capitalCity: Bern — a city with a real bear pit and 6 kilometers of arcades to walk under! 🐻
Switzerland.locationAndSize: A small mountain country in the heart of Europe that speaks FOUR languages!
Switzerland.language: German, French, Italian, AND Romansh — four languages in one tiny country!
Switzerland.cultureAndTraditions: Swiss chocolate is the most famous in the world! 🍫 Switzerland also makes the most accurate watches and has the most beautiful mountains — the Matterhorn looks like a pyramid made by giants! And there are real people who yodel and play enormous horns called alphorns!
Switzerland.natureAndWildlife: Ibex — mountain goats that can climb nearly vertical walls — live in the Alps. Marmots whistle warnings, and the bearded vulture with a 3-meter wingspan soars above
Switzerland.friendlyPeople: Switzerland has been peaceful for over 200 years — all four languages and cultures live happily together sharing fondue! 🧀

Ukraine.capitalCity: Kyiv — one of the oldest and most beautiful cities in Eastern Europe! 🌻
Ukraine.locationAndSize: The largest country entirely in Europe — vast sunflower fields, deep forests, and the Carpathian Mountains
Ukraine.language: Ukrainian — a melodic Slavic language that sounds like a song
Ukraine.cultureAndTraditions: Ukrainian Easter eggs called pysanky are decorated with the most intricate magical patterns — every line and color has a special meaning! 🥚 Ukrainians also embroider beautiful patterns on shirts called vyshyvanka — like wearing art! The sunflower is their national flower 🌻
Ukraine.natureAndWildlife: Przewalski's horses — the last truly wild horses on Earth — live in Ukraine. White storks nest on rooftops, and the Carpathians are home to bears, wolves, and lynx
Ukraine.friendlyPeople: Ukrainian people are famous for their bravery and love of their homeland — and for making the most delicious borscht soup in the world!

videos.title: Ukraine — sunflowers and brave hearts

United Kingdom.capitalCity: London — city of Big Ben, red buses, and the Queen's guards! 🏰🚌
United Kingdom.locationAndSize: An island nation in Northwest Europe — England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland together
United Kingdom.language: English — the most widely spoken language in the world, plus Welsh and Scottish Gaelic
United Kingdom.cultureAndTraditions: Harry Potter was born in Britain — and the real Hogwarts train departs from King's Cross Station in London! 🧙 Also Paddington Bear is from London, Winnie the Pooh is from England, and Peter Pan flies over London!
United Kingdom.natureAndWildlife: Fluffy red squirrels hide in Scottish forests, Loch Ness in Scotland might hide a friendly monster, puffins nest on sea cliffs, and Highland cattle have the longest hair!
United Kingdom.friendlyPeople: British people believe a cup of tea solves every problem — and have tea with milk at least three times per day! ☕

Vatican City.capitalCity: Vatican City — the whole country is just one city! 🌍✝️
Vatican City.locationAndSize: The smallest country in the entire world — you can walk around the whole country in 20 minutes!
Vatican City.language: Italian and Latin — the same language ancient Romans spoke 2,000 years ago!
Vatican City.cultureAndTraditions: Michelangelo painted the entire ceiling of the Sistine Chapel lying on his back for 4 years — 500 years ago! The painting is still perfect today! 🎨 The Pope lives here and waves to thousands of children every Sunday from his window!
Vatican City.natureAndWildlife: The Vatican Gardens have peacocks strutting around the paths, and ancient rose gardens fill the air with fragrance
Vatican City.friendlyPeople: Vatican City has its own guards called Swiss Guards who wear the most colorful striped uniforms — designed by Michelangelo himself! They are serious but the costumes are very cheerful!

videos.title: Vatican — world's tiniest country

Canada.capitalCity: Ottawa — a calm capital with a river that freezes into a skating road in winter! ⛸️
Canada.locationAndSize: A giant country in North America with more lakes than any other country on Earth
Canada.language: English and French — two official languages, like having two storybooks at once!
Canada.cultureAndTraditions: Canada loves maple syrup — sweet tree juice you can pour on pancakes! 🍁 They also have big winter festivals with ice castles and snow sculptures
Canada.natureAndWildlife: Moose taller than a person, beavers that build dams like tiny engineers, polar bears in the far north, and whales along the coasts
Canada.friendlyPeople: Canadians are famous for being polite — they even say sorry when YOU bump into THEM!

United States.capitalCity: Washington, D.C. — a city of big white buildings and museums full of treasures 🏛️
United States.locationAndSize: A huge country in North America with deserts, mountains, forests, and beaches — like many worlds in one!
United States.language: English — plus hundreds of other languages spoken by families from all over the world
United States.cultureAndTraditions: The USA is home to Hollywood movies, jazz music, and giant parades. Many kids celebrate Thanksgiving with a big family meal and gratitude stories 🦃
United States.natureAndWildlife: Bison on wide plains, alligators in swamps, bald eagles soaring, and geysers and hot springs in Yellowstone
United States.friendlyPeople: People love road trips — packing snacks, singing songs in the car, and traveling across big open spaces together 🚗

Mexico.capitalCity: Mexico City — a huge high-altitude city with ancient pyramids nearby! 🌋
Mexico.locationAndSize: A colorful country in North America between the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea
Mexico.language: Spanish — plus many indigenous languages like Nahuatl and Maya
Mexico.cultureAndTraditions: Day of the Dead is a joyful festival with candles, flowers, and sugar skulls — a way to remember loved ones with smiles and stories 💀🌼
Mexico.natureAndWildlife: Monarch butterflies arrive in millions like flying orange leaves, jaguars prowl in jungles, and whales visit warm seas
Mexico.friendlyPeople: Mexican families love sharing food — warm tortillas, tacos, and sweet churros that taste like cinnamon dreams!

Guatemala.capitalCity: Guatemala City — a busy city surrounded by volcanoes 🌋
Guatemala.locationAndSize: A Central American country with jungles, lakes, and ancient Maya cities
Guatemala.language: Spanish plus many Maya languages — like K'iche' and Q'eqchi'
Guatemala.cultureAndTraditions: Colorful woven clothes and markets sparkle with patterns. At Easter, streets in Antigua are covered in beautiful flower carpets called alfombras 🌸
Guatemala.natureAndWildlife: Quetzals — bright green birds with long tail feathers — live in misty cloud forests, and monkeys swing in the jungle
Guatemala.friendlyPeople: People love telling Maya legends about stars, animals, and brave heroes around warm meals and sweet cocoa

Belize.capitalCity: Belmopan — a small capital near the rainforest 🌴
Belize.locationAndSize: A tiny Central American country with the second-largest coral reef in the world
Belize.language: English — plus Creole, Spanish, and Maya languages
Belize.cultureAndTraditions: Belize is a mix of cultures — Garifuna drums, Maya stories, and Caribbean rhythms all in one happy place 🥁
Belize.natureAndWildlife: Jaguars, toucans, howler monkeys, and sea turtles near bright coral gardens
Belize.friendlyPeople: Belizeans greet you with a smile and 'Good morning!' even if they just met you

Honduras.language: Spanish — plus indigenous languages like Garifuna and Miskito
Honduras.cultureAndTraditions: The ancient Maya city of Copán has stone carvings that look like a giant history comic book 📜
Honduras.natureAndWildlife: Scarlet macaws fly like red-and-blue fireworks, and coral reefs sparkle near the Bay Islands

El Salvador.capitalCity: San Salvador — a city with volcanoes on the horizon 🌋
El Salvador.locationAndSize: The smallest country in Central America — but packed with beaches and volcanoes!
El Salvador.cultureAndTraditions: Pupusas — warm stuffed corn cakes — are the national favorite snack, often eaten with crunchy cabbage salad 🫓
El Salvador.natureAndWildlife: Sea turtles nest on sandy beaches, and green forests grow on volcanic slopes
El Salvador.friendlyPeople: People love welcoming visitors with food and stories — sharing is a superpower here!

Nicaragua.natureAndWildlife: Howler monkeys, sloths, and bright tropical birds live in forests; sea turtles visit the coasts

Costa Rica.locationAndSize: A Central American country between two oceans — the Pacific and the Caribbean
Costa Rica.cultureAndTraditions: Costa Rica protects nature like a superhero — many forests are national parks, and people say 'Pura Vida' meaning 'pure life!' 🌱
Costa Rica.natureAndWildlife: Sloths hang upside down in trees, colorful frogs glow like jewels, and hummingbirds buzz like tiny helicopters
Costa Rica.friendlyPeople: Kids learn to love animals and forests — taking care of nature is part of everyday life

Panama.capitalCity: Panama City — skyscrapers on one side, jungle on the other! 🌆🌴
Panama.locationAndSize: A narrow bridge of land connecting North and South America
Panama.cultureAndTraditions: The Panama Canal is a giant water elevator for ships — boats travel between two oceans like magic! 🚢
Panama.natureAndWildlife: Colorful poison dart frogs, sloths, and tropical birds live in the rainforest; dolphins swim near the coasts
Panama.friendlyPeople: Panamanians love bright festivals with traditional hats and swirling pollera dresses

Dominican Republic.locationAndSize: A Caribbean country sharing the island of Hispaniola with Haiti

Jamaica.locationAndSize: A Caribbean island with mountains and bright beaches
Jamaica.language: English — plus Jamaican Patois, a fun local way of speaking

Jamaica.natureAndWildlife: Hummingbirds, blue mountains, waterfalls, and coral reefs near the shore

Trinidad and Tobago.locationAndSize: Two islands at the southern edge of the Caribbean, close to South America
Trinidad and Tobago.cultureAndTraditions: Carnival is a glittering explosion of costumes, steel drums, and dancing in the streets — like a rainbow parade that lasts for days! 🌈
Trinidad and Tobago.natureAndWildlife: Scarlet ibis birds fly in red flocks, leatherback turtles nest on beaches, and rainforests hide curious animals
Trinidad and Tobago.friendlyPeople: People love music — especially steelpan drums that sound like magic bells

Barbados.capitalCity: Bridgetown — a seaside capital with gentle waves 🌊
Barbados.locationAndSize: A small Caribbean island made of coral and sunshine
Barbados.cultureAndTraditions: Crop Over is a big festival with music, dancing, and colorful costumes celebrating the end of the sugarcane harvest 🎉
Barbados.natureAndWildlife: Sea turtles swim near coral reefs, and flying fish sparkle above the water like tiny silver rockets

Saint Lucia.language: English — and Saint Lucian Creole French (Kwéyòl)

Grenada.locationAndSize: A small Caribbean island known as the 'Spice Isle'
Grenada.cultureAndTraditions: Grenada grows nutmeg, cinnamon, and cocoa — the air can smell like cookies! 🍪
Grenada.natureAndWildlife: Rainforests, waterfalls, and colorful fish around coral reefs
Grenada.friendlyPeople: People are gentle and welcoming — they love sharing fruit, stories, and island music

Antigua and Barbuda.capitalCity: St. John's — a sunny capital with a bright harbor 🏝️
Antigua and Barbuda.locationAndSize: Two Caribbean islands famous for beaches — people say there is a beach for every day of the year!
Antigua and Barbuda.cultureAndTraditions: Sailing is a big deal — colorful boats race on the sea like flying birds ⛵
Antigua and Barbuda.natureAndWildlife: Sea turtles, coral reefs, and tropical birds in mangroves
Antigua and Barbuda.friendlyPeople: Islanders love welcoming guests with music and cheerful greetings

Dominica.capitalCity: Roseau — a small capital near wild green mountains 🌿
Dominica.locationAndSize: A Caribbean island covered in rainforest — called the 'Nature Island'
Dominica.cultureAndTraditions: People celebrate with drums and dances, and the island has a famous boiling lake that looks like a wizard's cauldron! 🫧
Dominica.natureAndWildlife: Parrots, waterfalls, hot springs, and whales off the coast
Dominica.friendlyPeople: Dominicans love nature — hikes, rivers, and picnics are part of island life

Saint Kitts and Nevis.capitalCity: Basseterre — a small capital by the sea 🌊
Saint Kitts and Nevis.locationAndSize: Two little Caribbean islands with a big green volcano mountain
Saint Kitts and Nevis.cultureAndTraditions: A tiny train once carried sugarcane — today it takes visitors on a fun island journey like a storybook ride 🚂
Saint Kitts and Nevis.natureAndWildlife: Monkeys in the forest, bright fish in reefs, and sea turtles in warm bays
Saint Kitts and Nevis.friendlyPeople: Life is slow and friendly — people wave and smile like you are already their friend

Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.capitalCity: Kingstown — a harbor city with boats and palm trees ⛵
Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.locationAndSize: A Caribbean country made of many small islands sprinkled in the sea
Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.cultureAndTraditions: Some islands look like pirate treasure maps — hidden coves, sails, and songs in the wind 🏴‍☠️
Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.natureAndWildlife: Coral reefs, sea turtles, and green hills with volcanic peaks
Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.friendlyPeople: Islanders love sharing fresh fruit and telling sea stories at sunset

Argentina.capitalCity: Buenos Aires — a city that never sleeps, full of tango dancers and amazing beef! 💃🥩
Argentina.locationAndSize: A huge country at the very bottom of South America — the 8th largest in the whole world!
Argentina.language: Spanish — but with a special musical Italian-like accent unlike anywhere else!
Argentina.cultureAndTraditions: Argentinians invented the tango — the most passionate and dramatic dance in the world! 💃 Also Argentina has the most amazing football players — Lionel Messi is from here! And gauchos are Argentine cowboys who ride horses across endless grassy plains called pampas 🐎
Argentina.natureAndWildlife: Penguins waddle on the beaches in Patagonia! Condors soar over the Andes with wings wider than a car. Jaguars hide in the northern jungle and pink flamingos color the salt lakes
Argentina.friendlyPeople: Argentinians drink a special green tea called mate through a metal straw and always share it with friends — refusing to share is considered very rude! 🍵

Bolivia.capitalCity: Sucre (official) and La Paz — one of the highest capital cities in the world, in the clouds! ☁️
Bolivia.locationAndSize: A magical landlocked country in the heart of South America with the world's largest salt flat!
Bolivia.language: Spanish plus 36 indigenous languages — more official languages than any other country!
Bolivia.cultureAndTraditions: Bolivia has the most amazing market in the world — Witches' Market in La Paz where you can buy magical potions, dried frogs, and lucky charms! 🧙 Also Bolivian women wear beautiful bowler hats and colorful skirts with many layers!
Bolivia.natureAndWildlife: Salar de Uyuni is the world's biggest mirror — a salt flat so flat and white that when it rains it reflects the sky perfectly like glass! 🌅 Pink flamingos, vicuñas (fluffy relatives of camels), and spectacled bears live here
Bolivia.friendlyPeople: Bolivian children celebrate Carnival with water balloons and colored powder — the whole country turns into one giant water fight! 💦

Brazil.capitalCity: Brasília — a futuristic city shaped like an airplane from above! ✈️
Brazil.locationAndSize: The biggest country in South America — so big that almost all of Europe would fit inside it!
Brazil.language: Portuguese — the only country in South America that speaks Portuguese!
Brazil.cultureAndTraditions: Rio Carnival is the biggest party on Earth — millions of people dance in incredible colorful costumes for five whole days and nights! 🎉 Brazil also has the most football World Cup wins ever — football is practically the national religion! Brazil.natureAndWildlife: The Amazon Rainforest is home to more species than anywhere on Earth — jaguars, pink river dolphins, poison dart frogs, electric eels, toucans, and 40,000 types of plants!

Chile.capitalCity: Santiago — a modern city with snowy Andes mountains right behind it! 🏔️
Chile.locationAndSize: The longest and skinniest country in the world — 4,300 km long but only 177 km wide on average!
Chile.language: Spanish — with a very fast and unique Chilean accent
Chile.cultureAndTraditions: Chile is so long it has every climate on Earth — from the driest desert in the north to glaciers and penguins in the south! 🐧 Easter Island belongs to Chile — mysterious giant stone heads called Moai stand on the shore looking at the sea 🗿
Chile.natureAndWildlife: Atacama Desert is so dry that some places have never had rain in recorded history. Humboldt penguins, pumas, flamingos in high altitude lakes, and blue whales in the sea
Chile.friendlyPeople: Chilean people are very proud of their empanadas — little pastry pockets stuffed with meat and onion, eaten at every celebration!

Colombia.capitalCity: Bogotá — a city in the clouds at 2,600 meters above sea level! ☁️🎨
Colombia.locationAndSize: A beautiful country in the northwest corner of South America touching both the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea!
Colombia.language: Spanish — spoken with one of the clearest and most beautiful accents in Latin America
Colombia.cultureAndTraditions: Colombia is the flower capital of the world — they export more flowers than almost anyone! 🌸 The Flower Festival in Medellín has a parade where people carry giant flower arrangements on their backs — some weigh 80 kilograms! Colombia.natureAndWildlife: Colombia has more species of birds than any other country — over 1,900 types! Poison dart frogs glow in neon colors, pink river dolphins swim in the Amazon, and spectacled bears climb the Andes
Colombia.friendlyPeople: Colombians call everyone 'parcero' which means friend — even strangers are treated like old friends from the first moment!

Ecuador.capitalCity: Quito — one of the highest capital cities in the world, right on the equator! 🌍
Ecuador.locationAndSize: A small country right in the middle of the world — the equator (0° latitude) runs through it, that is how it got its name!
Ecuador.language: Spanish and Kichwa — an ancient indigenous language
Ecuador.cultureAndTraditions: You can stand with one foot in the Northern Hemisphere and one foot in the Southern Hemisphere at the same time! 🌍 The Galápagos Islands belong to Ecuador — the most magical islands in the world where animals have never been afraid of humans!
Ecuador.natureAndWildlife: Galápagos giant tortoises are 180 years old and as big as a coffee table! 🐢 Blue-footed boobies do a funny dance, marine iguanas swim in the sea, and sea lions sleep on park benches!
Ecuador.friendlyPeople: Ecuadorian children eat the most colorful fruit in the world — dragon fruit, naranjilla, maracuyá, and tree tomatoes that grow nowhere else!

videos.title: Ecuador — Galápagos magical islands

Guyana.capitalCity: Georgetown — a city with wooden Victorian houses painted in bright colors! 🏠
Guyana.locationAndSize: A small country on the northern coast of South America — the only English-speaking country on the continent!
Guyana.language: English — surrounded by Spanish and Portuguese speaking neighbors!
Guyana.cultureAndTraditions: Guyana has one of the most spectacular waterfalls in the world — Kaieteur Falls is four times higher than Niagara Falls and falls into a deep gorge surrounded by pristine jungle! 💦
Guyana.natureAndWildlife: Giant anteaters shuffle through the savanna, giant river otters wrestle in rivers, harpy eagles (the most powerful eagle in the world!) nest in ancient trees, and scarlet macaws fly in flocks
Guyana.friendlyPeople: Guyanese people mix African, Indian, Chinese, European, and indigenous cultures together — their food, music, and festivals are a wonderful colorful blend of everything!
