Paraguay.capitalCity: Asunción — one of the oldest cities in South America, full of history! 🏛️
Paraguay.locationAndSize: A landlocked country in the heart of South America between Brazil, Argentina, and Bolivia
Paraguay.language: Spanish AND Guaraní — one of the few countries where an indigenous language is spoken by almost everyone!
Paraguay.cultureAndTraditions: Paraguay has the world's largest water reservoir hidden underground — the Guaraní Aquifer! 💧 Also Paraguayan women make beautiful lace called ñandutí — they weave it in circular patterns like spider webs in every color of the rainbow 🕸️
Paraguay.natureAndWildlife: Giant armadillos dig enormous burrows, maned wolves with very long legs trot through the grasslands, and capybaras — the world's largest rodents — swim in every river
Paraguay.friendlyPeople: Paraguay is the only country in the world where a spider web inspired the national handicraft — ñandutí means 'spider web' in Guaraní!

videos.title: Paraguay — spiderweb lace and giant creatures

Peru.capitalCity: Lima — a foggy city by the Pacific Ocean that almost never rains! 🌫️
Peru.locationAndSize: A large country on the west coast of South America — home of the ancient Inca Empire!
Peru.language: Spanish, Quechua, and Aymara — the Inca language Quechua is still spoken by millions!
Peru.cultureAndTraditions: Machu Picchu is a magical ancient Inca city built on top of a cloud-covered mountain — nobody knows exactly how they carried the giant stones up there! 🏔️ Also llamas and alpacas walk through the streets — alpaca wool makes the softest sweaters in the world! 🦙
Peru.natureAndWildlife: The Amazon starts in Peru from a tiny stream in the Andes! Pink river dolphins swim in jungle rivers, giant condors soar over mountains, and spectacled bears climb misty cloud forests
Peru.friendlyPeople: Peruvian children celebrate Inti Raymi — the Festival of the Sun — with costumes, dancing, and offerings to thank the sun for its warmth and light! ☀️

photos.caption: Fluffy alpacas on the Inca trail

videos.title: Peru — Inca magic and alpacas

Suriname.capitalCity: Paramaribo — a wooden city so well preserved it is a UNESCO World Heritage Site! 🏘️
Suriname.locationAndSize: The smallest country in South America — but with 90% of it covered in pristine tropical rainforest!
Suriname.language: Dutch — the only Dutch-speaking country in South America, a surprise to everyone!
Suriname.cultureAndTraditions: Suriname is the most diverse country in South America — people from Africa, India, Java, China, and Europe all live together and celebrate each other's festivals! 🌍 The result is the most amazing mix of foods, music, and traditions!
Suriname.natureAndWildlife: 90% of Suriname is untouched rainforest! Jaguars prowl, giant river otters play, harpy eagles hunt, and leatherback sea turtles — the biggest turtles in the world — lay eggs on the beaches at night 🐢
Suriname.friendlyPeople: In Suriname you can eat Indonesian nasi goreng for breakfast, Indian roti for lunch, and Creole pepper pot for dinner — every day is a world food festival!

videos.title: Suriname — world in one tiny country

Uruguay.capitalCity: Montevideo — a sunny friendly city right on the Rio de la Plata river! ☀️
Uruguay.locationAndSize: The second smallest country in South America — but one of the happiest and most peaceful!
Uruguay.language: Spanish — with a lovely lilting River Plate accent
Uruguay.cultureAndTraditions: Uruguay has the longest Carnival celebration in the world — it lasts 40 days! 🎉 The candombe drums are so powerful you can feel them in your chest. Also Uruguay was one of the first countries to give rights to animals and to protect nature — they truly love all living creatures 🐾
Uruguay.natureAndWildlife: South American sea lions sunbathe on Montevideo's waterfront! Capybaras graze in city parks, rheas (South American ostriches) run across grasslands, and nesting penguins visit in winter 🐧
Uruguay.friendlyPeople: Uruguayans are the most relaxed and happy people in South America — they spend evenings walking by the sea, drinking mate, and watching sunsets together 🌅

videos.title: Uruguay — carnival sea lions and sunsets

Venezuela.capitalCity: Caracas — a city surrounded by mountains and green national parks! 🌿
Venezuela.locationAndSize: A country on the northern coast of South America touching the warm Caribbean Sea
Venezuela.language: Spanish — spoken with an energetic Caribbean rhythm
Venezuela.cultureAndTraditions: Venezuela has the highest waterfall in the world — Angel Falls drops 979 meters, which is 15 times higher than Niagara Falls! 🌊 The water falls so far it turns into mist before reaching the bottom! Also Venezuela's table-top mountains called tepuis are so isolated that unique animals and plants evolved there found nowhere else on Earth
Venezuela.natureAndWildlife: Angel Falls, giant anteaters, giant otters, scarlet macaws, capybaras, and the mysterious tepui mountains where carnivorous plants eat insects!
Venezuela.friendlyPeople: Venezuelan people are warm, musical, and love to dance — salsa, merengue, and joropo music fill every street and plaza with joy! 💃

photos.caption: Tepui flat-top mountains in the clouds

videos.title: Venezuela — Angel Falls and lost worlds

Afghanistan.capitalCity: Kabul — a mountain city where snowy peaks circle the houses like a stone crown 🏔️
Afghanistan.locationAndSize: A landlocked country in the heart of Asia, full of high mountains and ancient trade routes
Afghanistan.language: Dari and Pashto — two poetic languages used to tell old legends and poems
Afghanistan.cultureAndTraditions: Afghanistan lies on the Silk Road — for thousands of years traders brought spices, silk, and stories through its valleys 🐪. Colorful kites dance in the sky during festivals!
Afghanistan.natureAndWildlife: Snow leopards stalk the high mountains, Marco Polo sheep climb steep cliffs, and pomegranate orchards glow red in the sun
Afghanistan.friendlyPeople: Afghan families always offer guests tea and bread, even when they have very little — sharing is a sacred rule ☕

videos.title: Afghanistan — mountains, caravans, and kites

Armenia.capitalCity: Yerevan — a pink stone city with a snowy volcano-shaped mountain watching from afar 🗻
Armenia.locationAndSize: A small, very ancient country in the mountains between Europe and Asia
Armenia.language: Armenian — with its own special alphabet that looks like curly magic symbols
Armenia.cultureAndTraditions: Armenia was one of the first Christian countries in the world — tiny stone churches sit on hilltops like storybook houses ⛪. Apricots and pomegranates are beloved fruits and symbols of joy
Armenia.natureAndWildlife: Mount Ararat rises like a giant from the clouds, eagles circle mountain valleys, and high lakes shine like pieces of sky
Armenia.friendlyPeople: Armenian grandmothers never let you leave hungry — they fill the table with bread, cheese, herbs, and sweets for every guest!

photos.caption: Monastery on a cliff below Mount Ararat
Pink tuff stone buildings in Yerevan

videos.title: Armenia — apricot land of mountains

Azerbaijan.capitalCity: Baku — a city on the Caspian Sea where flame-shaped towers glow at night 🔥
Azerbaijan.locationAndSize: A country between the Caucasus Mountains and the Caspian Sea, sometimes called the Land of Fire
Azerbaijan.language: Azerbaijani — a Turkic language with singing sounds
Azerbaijan.cultureAndTraditions: Natural gas escapes from the ground and creates 'eternal flames' that have burned for thousands of years! People celebrate Novruz, the spring festival, by jumping over bonfires to leave worries behind 🔥
Azerbaijan.natureAndWildlife: High mountain meadows, mud volcanoes that bubble like cauldrons, and rare leopards and bears in deep forests
Azerbaijan.friendlyPeople: Azerbaijani hospitality means endless tea, sweets, and stories — leaving a guest hungry would be a great shame!

photos.caption: Mud volcanoes on the Caspian coast

videos.title: Azerbaijan — land of fire and tea

Georgia.capitalCity: Tbilisi — a city of hot springs and colorful balconies hanging over a river 🏘️
Georgia.locationAndSize: A small mountainous country between Europe and Asia on the Black Sea
Georgia.language: Georgian — with a round, swirly alphabet that looks like little clouds writing
Georgia.cultureAndTraditions: Georgia claims to be the birthplace of wine — people have been making wine in clay pots buried underground for 8,000 years! 🍇 Traditional feasts called supra last for hours with songs and toasts
Georgia.natureAndWildlife: Snowy Caucasus peaks, green valleys full of vineyards, and brown bears and wolves in the forests
Georgia.friendlyPeople: Georgians love guests so much there is a saying: 'A guest is a gift from God' — expect too much food and too many songs!

photos.caption: Tbilisi old town with wooden balconies

videos.title: Georgia — mountains, wine, and songs

Bahrain.capitalCity: Manama — a shiny modern city on islands in the warm Gulf 🏙️
Bahrain.locationAndSize: A tiny island country in the Persian Gulf connected to Saudi Arabia by a long bridge
Bahrain.language: Arabic — the language of beautiful calligraphy
Bahrain.cultureAndTraditions: Before oil, people here were famous pearl divers — they searched the sea for glowing white pearls inside oysters 🐚. Today there are big festivals and even Formula 1 races!
Bahrain.natureAndWildlife: Palm trees, desert dunes, and the 'Tree of Life' — a lonely tree that somehow lives in the middle of the desert
Bahrain.friendlyPeople: Bahrainis love family gatherings with dates, coffee, and long conversations late into the night

videos.title: Bahrain — pearls, palms, and skyscrapers

Bangladesh.capitalCity: Dhaka — a super busy city full of colorful rickshaws and boats 🛶
Bangladesh.locationAndSize: A green, low-lying country in South Asia where many rivers meet the sea
Bangladesh.language: Bangla (Bengali) — a poetic language loved by famous writers and singers
Bangladesh.cultureAndTraditions: The Bengali New Year fills streets with music, masks, and giant colorful animal figures! The country is famous for its beautiful hand-woven cotton clothes and saris
Bangladesh.natureAndWildlife: The Sundarbans is the largest mangrove forest on Earth and home to swimming Bengal tigers, crocodiles, and dolphins 🐅
Bangladesh.friendlyPeople: Bangladeshi people love offering guests sweet tea and snacks — even strangers are welcomed like old friends

videos.title: Bangladesh — rivers, tigers, and festivals

Bhutan.capitalCity: Thimphu — a mountain capital with no traffic lights, only friendly policemen 👮
Bhutan.locationAndSize: A tiny Himalayan kingdom high in the mountains between India and China
Bhutan.language: Dzongkha — the language of monasteries and mountain villages
Bhutan.cultureAndTraditions: Bhutan measures success in Gross National Happiness instead of money — they officially care most about people being happy! Monks in orange robes live in cliff-hanging monasteries 🧘
Bhutan.natureAndWildlife: Snow leopards, red pandas, and takins (a funny goat-cow animal) roam forests on the sides of steep valleys
Bhutan.friendlyPeople: Bhutanese people believe in kindness to all living beings — even stray dogs are gently cared for in the streets

photos.caption: Tiger's Nest monastery on a cliff

videos.title: Bhutan — kingdom of happiness

Brunei.capitalCity: Bandar Seri Begawan — a city with a golden-domed mosque and houses on stilts over the river 🕌
Brunei.locationAndSize: A very small, very rich country on the island of Borneo in Southeast Asia
Brunei.language: Malay — and many people also speak English
Brunei.cultureAndTraditions: Many families live in Kampong Ayer, a 'water village' where wooden walkways connect houses above the river. Boats are like cars here! 🚤
Brunei.natureAndWildlife: Dense rainforest full of proboscis monkeys with funny big noses, hornbills, and glowing fireflies at night
Brunei.friendlyPeople: Bruneians enjoy calm, family-centered lives and love sharing sweet tea and snacks with visitors

photos.caption: Golden mosque reflected in the water

videos.title: Brunei — rainforest and water villages

Cambodia.capitalCity: Phnom Penh — a riverside city with golden temple roofs shining in the sun 🛕
Cambodia.locationAndSize: A Southeast Asian country with ancient temples and rice fields
Cambodia.language: Khmer — written with curly letters that look like loops and waves
Cambodia.cultureAndTraditions: Angkor Wat is the largest religious temple complex in the world — carved stone towers rise from the jungle like something from a lost kingdom 🏰
Cambodia.natureAndWildlife: The Mekong River flows through, full of giant catfish and rare dolphins. Rice paddies glow green, and tropical forests hide elephants and gibbons
Cambodia.friendlyPeople: Cambodians greet each other with a smile and palms pressed together — a gesture of respect and warmth

photos.caption: Cambodian rice fields and palm trees

videos.title: Cambodia — temples, rivers, and smiles

China.capitalCity: Beijing — a huge city with a Forbidden City palace that used to be home to emperors 🏯
China.locationAndSize: One of the largest countries in the world, stretching from deserts to tropical seas
China.language: Chinese (Mandarin) — the most spoken language on Earth
China.cultureAndTraditions: The Great Wall of China is so long it could wrap around the moon if unrolled! 🧱 People celebrate Lunar New Year with red lanterns, dragon dances, and fireworks
China.natureAndWildlife: Pandas munch bamboo in misty mountains, snow leopards hunt in the west, and karst mountains rise like dragon teeth from green rivers 🐼
China.friendlyPeople: Sharing food is very important — families gather around round tables full of dumplings, noodles, and tea and talk for hours

photos.caption: Great Wall winding over the hills

videos.title: China — dragons, walls, and pandas

India.capitalCity: New Delhi — a bustling city of ancient forts and busy markets full of colors 🎨
India.locationAndSize: A huge South Asian country almost as big as all of Western Europe combined
India.language: India has 22 official languages — Hindi and English are widely used, but hundreds of others are spoken too!
India.cultureAndTraditions: Holi, the festival of colors, turns streets into rainbows as people throw bright powders at each other 🌈. Diwali, the festival of lights, fills homes with candles, lamps, and fireworks
India.natureAndWildlife: From snowy Himalayas to tiger-filled jungles and palm-fringed beaches, India is a treasure chest of animals: tigers, elephants, peacocks, and monkeys 🐅
India.friendlyPeople: Indian families love feeding guests — you might be given spicy curry, naan bread, and sweet gulab jamun balls until you can’t eat another bite!

photos.caption: Holi festival colors in the air

videos.title: India — colors, festivals, and tigers

Indonesia.capitalCity: Jakarta — a mega-city on the island of Java full of scooters and skyscrapers 🏙️
Indonesia.locationAndSize: The world's largest island country with over 17,000 islands between the Indian and Pacific Oceans
Indonesia.language: Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) — unites hundreds of different ethnic groups and languages
Indonesia.cultureAndTraditions: On Bali, colorful offerings of flowers and rice are placed everywhere for the gods. Traditional dances tell stories of demons, heroes, and monkeys in golden masks 🐒
Indonesia.natureAndWildlife: Komodo dragons — the largest lizards on Earth — prowl dry islands. Orangutans swing in the rainforests of Borneo and Sumatra, and volcanoes smoke above emerald rice terraces
Indonesia.friendlyPeople: Indonesians often greet with a warm smile and the word 'Selamat' — wishing you safety and happiness

photos.caption: Rice terraces and temples in Bali

videos.title: Indonesia — islands, dragons, and jungles

Iran.capitalCity: Tehran — a big city under snow-capped mountains filled with bazaars and museums 🏔️
Iran.locationAndSize: A large country in Western Asia, once part of the mighty Persian Empire
Iran.language: Persian (Farsi) — a language of poetry and fairy tales about heroes and flying carpets
Iran.cultureAndTraditions: Persian carpets are hand-woven works of art that can take years to finish 🧶. During Nowruz, the Persian New Year, families set special tables with seven symbolic items for good luck
Iran.natureAndWildlife: From hot deserts with salt lakes that look like mirrors to green forests and snowy ski slopes, Iran has many faces. Asiatic cheetahs and Persian leopards still live in the wild
Iran.friendlyPeople: Iranian hospitality is legendary — guests are showered with tea, sweets, and invitations to stay longer than planned!

photos.caption: Colorful tiles inside a Persian mosque

videos.title: Iran — carpets, poetry, and ancient cities

Iraq.capitalCity: Baghdad — once the center of the ancient world of science and stories 📚
Iraq.locationAndSize: A country in Western Asia where the Tigris and Euphrates rivers flow through desert and fields
Iraq.language: Arabic and Kurdish — two main languages with many local dialects
Iraq.cultureAndTraditions: The tales of 'One Thousand and One Nights' with Aladdin and flying carpets grew from this region. Long ago, Baghdad’s House of Wisdom gathered the smartest scholars of the world
Iraq.natureAndWildlife: Date palm groves stretch along rivers, and marshlands in the south are like a watery maze full of reeds and birds
Iraq.friendlyPeople: Iraqi hospitality means endless tiny cups of strong, sweet tea and coffee, and always one more plate of food

videos.title: Iraq — rivers, stories, and date palms

Israel.capitalCity: Jerusalem — a holy city for three major religions with ancient stone streets and golden domes ✨
Israel.locationAndSize: A small country on the eastern shore of the Mediterranean Sea
Israel.language: Hebrew and Arabic — and many people speak English and Russian too
Israel.cultureAndTraditions: People float like corks in the Dead Sea because the water is so salty 🧂. Jewish families light candles for Shabbat on Friday evenings and share special bread called challah
Israel.natureAndWildlife: From snowy Mount Hermon to desert craters and coral reefs in the Red Sea, Israel is very varied. Ibex climb cliffs like acrobats
Israel.friendlyPeople: Markets called shuk are full of shouting, bargaining, and laughter — and stall owners love giving children little tastes of sweets and fruit

photos.caption: Old City of Jerusalem with golden dome

videos.title: Israel — deserts, seas, and holy stories

Japan.capitalCity: Tokyo — a super modern city of neon lights, bullet trains, and tiny ramen shops 🍜
Japan.locationAndSize: An island nation in East Asia made of four main islands and thousands of smaller ones
Japan.language: Japanese — written with three different alphabets, like three sets of magical symbols
Japan.cultureAndTraditions: In spring, people picnic under cherry blossoms and celebrate hanami — 'flower viewing' 🌸. Samurai, ninja, geisha, anime, and video games all grew from Japanese culture!
Japan.natureAndWildlife: Volcanoes like Mount Fuji, hot springs where snow monkeys take baths, bamboo forests, and coral reefs full of tropical fish
Japan.friendlyPeople: Japanese politeness is famous — people bow, say 'arigatou', and even trains apologize if they are one minute late

videos.title: Japan — cherry blossoms, robots, and ramen

Jordan.capitalCity: Amman — a city of white houses climbing many hills 🏙️
Jordan.locationAndSize: A small desert country in the Middle East with incredible ancient ruins
Jordan.cultureAndTraditions: Petra, the 'rose-red city', was carved directly into the rock — you enter through a narrow canyon and suddenly see a giant temple glowing pink 🐫
Jordan.natureAndWildlife: The red desert of Wadi Rum looks like Mars with its sandstone towers. Camels, desert foxes, and eagles live in the wild areas
Jordan.friendlyPeople: Bedouin people serve tea and bread in goat-hair tents and tell stories by the campfire under a sky full of stars

videos.title: Jordan — rock cities and red deserts

Kazakhstan.capitalCity: Astana (Nur-Sultan) — a futuristic city with space-age buildings in the steppe 🏙️
Kazakhstan.locationAndSize: A huge landlocked country in Central Asia with endless grasslands called steppe
Kazakhstan.cultureAndTraditions: For centuries, Kazakh nomads lived in yurts — round felt tents — and rode horses across open plains 🐎. Eagle hunters still train golden eagles to help them hunt
Kazakhstan.natureAndWildlife: Wild horses, saiga antelopes with funny noses, and eagles soar over wide skies. In the east, high mountains sparkle with snow
Kazakhstan.friendlyPeople: Even today, being a guest in a Kazakh home means being treated like royalty with tea, bread, and many meat dishes

photos.caption: Yurt on the open Kazakh steppe
Golden eagle on a hunter's arm

videos.title: Kazakhstan — steppe, horses, and eagles

Kyrgyzstan.capitalCity: Bishkek — a leafy city at the foot of tall snowy mountains 🏔️
Kyrgyzstan.locationAndSize: A mountainous country in Central Asia covered by the Tien Shan 'Celestial Mountains'
Kyrgyzstan.cultureAndTraditions: Kyrgyz people have long been nomads, moving with their herds and living in white felt yurts. Horse games and long epic poems are important parts of culture 🐎
Kyrgyzstan.natureAndWildlife: Crystal mountain lakes like Issyk-Kul, glaciers, edelweiss flowers, and snow leopards in high rocky areas
Kyrgyzstan.friendlyPeople: Travelers staying in yurts are given hot tea, fresh bread, and a warm bed — even in the middle of nowhere in the mountains

photos.caption: Horses grazing on green alpine pastures

videos.title: Kyrgyzstan — yurts, horses, and high mountains

Laos.capitalCity: Vientiane — a quiet riverside capital with golden temples and sleepy streets 🌅
Laos.locationAndSize: A landlocked country in Southeast Asia covered in forests and crossed by the Mekong River
Laos.cultureAndTraditions: In the morning, long lines of monks in orange robes walk quietly through the streets while people give them food in a ceremony called alms giving 🧡
Laos.natureAndWildlife: Karst mountains and caves, waterfalls that look like steps, and forests with gibbons and elephants
Laos.friendlyPeople: Life in Laos is famously relaxed — people smile slowly, speak softly, and believe there is always time for another cup of tea

photos.caption: Turquoise waterfall pools in the forest

videos.title: Laos — temples, waterfalls, and quiet smiles

Lebanon.capitalCity: Beirut — a lively coastal city with cafes, music, and the blue Mediterranean Sea 🌊
Lebanon.locationAndSize: A tiny country on the eastern Mediterranean coast with high mountains
Lebanon.language: Arabic — and many people also speak French and English
Lebanon.cultureAndTraditions: Lebanon is famous for delicious mezze — many small plates full of hummus, tabbouleh, and warm bread 🫓. The ancient city of Byblos is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world
Lebanon.natureAndWildlife: Cedar trees, the symbol of the country, grow high in the mountains and can live for thousands of years 🌲
Lebanon.friendlyPeople: Lebanese people love gathering friends and family for long meals filled with laughter and music late into the night

photos.caption: Cedar trees in the Lebanese mountains

videos.title: Lebanon — cedars, coast, and cuisine

Malaysia.capitalCity: Kuala Lumpur — a city of skyscrapers, sky-bridges, and rainforests just outside the door 🌧️
Malaysia.locationAndSize: A Southeast Asian country split between the Malay Peninsula and the island of Borneo
Malaysia.language: Malay — and many people speak Chinese, Tamil, and English too
Malaysia.cultureAndTraditions: Malaysia is a mix of Malay, Chinese, Indian, and many other cultures, so festivals and foods from different traditions all live side by side 🎉
Malaysia.natureAndWildlife: Rainforests with orangutans, hornbills, and tiny mouse deer. On Borneo, Rafflesia flowers bloom as giant red 'monster flowers'
Malaysia.friendlyPeople: Malaysians love street food — night markets fill with families eating satay, noodles, and desserts together

photos.caption: Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur

videos.title: Malaysia — towers, jungles, and food stalls

Maldives.capitalCity: Malé — a tiny, colorful capital city that almost fills its own island 🏝️
Maldives.locationAndSize: A chain of over 1,000 coral islands in the Indian Ocean, just barely above sea level
Maldives.cultureAndTraditions: Life turns around the sea — fishing boats, coral reefs, and fruit from palm trees. Drums and dances happen on the beach under the stars 🌟
Maldives.natureAndWildlife: Crystal-clear water, mantas and whale sharks gliding through the sea, coral gardens, and coconut palms
Maldives.friendlyPeople: Maldivian island communities are tight-knit — everyone knows each other, and children grow up between sea and sand

photos.caption: Manta ray swimming in clear water

videos.title: Maldives — sea, sand, and coral dreams

Mongolia.capitalCity: Ulaanbaatar — a city where modern buildings stand beside round nomad tents called gers 🏕️
Mongolia.locationAndSize: A vast landlocked country in East Asia with endless grasslands and deserts
Mongolia.language: Mongolian — written in a tall, vertical script in traditional form
Mongolia.cultureAndTraditions: The Naadam festival celebrates 'the three manly games': wrestling, horse racing, and archery. Children as young as five ride racehorses across the steppe! 🐎
Mongolia.natureAndWildlife: The Gobi Desert has singing dunes and rare two-humped camels. Wild horses called Przewalski's horses live here too
Mongolia.friendlyPeople: Mongolian nomads welcome travelers into their gers with salty milk tea and dried cheese snacks, even in the middle of nowhere

photos.caption: Ger tent on the Mongolian steppe

videos.title: Mongolia — steppe, horses, and big skies

Myanmar.capitalCity: Naypyidaw (official) and Yangon — cities with golden pagodas that shine in the sun 🛕
Myanmar.locationAndSize: A Southeast Asian country between India, China, and Thailand with long rivers and many temples
Myanmar.cultureAndTraditions: In Bagan, thousands of brick temples rise from a misty plain like a stone forest. People wear thanaka paste on their faces to protect from the sun and for beauty 🌞
Myanmar.natureAndWildlife: Elephants, tigers, and rare snub-nosed monkeys live in the forests, while long narrow boats glide across mountain lakes
Myanmar.friendlyPeople: People greet with warm smiles and often invite strangers to share tea made with milk and sweet condensed milk

photos.caption: Fisherman on Inle Lake balancing on one leg

videos.title: Myanmar — temples, lakes, and golden pagodas

Nepal.capitalCity: Kathmandu — a valley city full of temples, prayer flags, and narrow alleys 🏯
Nepal.locationAndSize: A small country tucked into the Himalayas, home of Mount Everest — the highest mountain on Earth
Nepal.cultureAndTraditions: Colorful prayer flags flutter above mountain trails carrying good wishes on the wind. Many Sherpa people help climbers reach the highest peaks 🏔️
Nepal.natureAndWildlife: Snow leopards, yaks, red pandas, and rhinos in the lowland jungles of Chitwan National Park
Nepal.friendlyPeople: Nepalese people greet with palms together and say 'Namaste' — meaning 'I see the light in you' 🙏

videos.title: Nepal — Himalayas, temples, and yaks

North Korea.capitalCity: Pyongyang — a city of wide avenues, tall monuments, and carefully organized parades 🎏
North Korea.locationAndSize: A mountainous country in East Asia on the northern half of the Korean Peninsula
North Korea.cultureAndTraditions: Traditional Korean music and dance survive alongside strict modern rules. Colorful hanbok clothes and fan dances are still performed
North Korea.natureAndWildlife: Mountain ranges, forests, and coastal wetlands with many birds
North Korea.friendlyPeople: Ordinary Korean families, like everywhere, love their children, stories, and shared meals of rice and kimchi

videos.title: Korean Peninsula — mountains and traditions

South Korea.capitalCity: Seoul — a high-tech city where ancient palaces stand next to neon skyscrapers 🌆
South Korea.locationAndSize: A small, very modern country in East Asia on the southern half of the Korean Peninsula
South Korea.language: Korean — written with Hangul, an alphabet specially designed to be easy to learn
South Korea.cultureAndTraditions: K‑pop, K‑dramas, and video games from Korea are loved by kids all over the world 🎮. At the same time, people still wear traditional hanbok on holidays and visit old palaces
South Korea.natureAndWildlife: Green mountains, islands, and forests; cranes and deer live in quiet valleys
South Korea.friendlyPeople: Koreans share food from the middle of the table — dishes of kimchi, rice, and noodles that everyone eats together

videos.title: South Korea — palaces, pop music, and kimchi

Oman.capitalCity: Muscat — a calm white city between the sea and brown rocky mountains 🌊
Oman.locationAndSize: A peaceful country on the southeastern tip of the Arabian Peninsula
Oman.cultureAndTraditions: Frankincense, a tree resin that smells wonderful when burned, once made Oman very rich — caravans carried it across deserts like a sweet-smelling river of trade 🌳
Oman.natureAndWildlife: Golden sand dunes, green wadis with palm trees and pools, and sea turtles that nest on quiet beaches
Oman.friendlyPeople: Omanis are known for gentle manners and strong coffee with dates offered to guests as a sign of respect

photos.caption: Fort and mosque by the sea in Muscat
Palm-filled wadi oasis in the desert

videos.title: Oman — deserts, forts, and frankincense

Pakistan.capitalCity: Islamabad — a green, carefully planned city with a huge modern mosque 🕌
Pakistan.locationAndSize: A South Asian country with some of the highest mountains in the world in the north
Pakistan.language: Urdu and English as official languages, and many regional languages like Punjabi and Pashto
Pakistan.cultureAndTraditions: Truck art in Pakistan turns simple trucks into moving rainbows covered with flowers, birds, and mirrors 🚚. Cricket is a national obsession — street games are everywhere
Pakistan.natureAndWildlife: Karakoram and Himalayan peaks including K2, deserts, forests, and river plains home to snow leopards, markhor goats, and river dolphins
Pakistan.friendlyPeople: Guests are treated with big plates of biryani rice, sweet mangoes, and strong chai — refusing more food is very difficult!

videos.title: Pakistan — peaks, patterns, and cricket

Philippines.capitalCity: Manila — a buzzing city on a big bay, full of jeepneys painted like comic books 🚍
Philippines.locationAndSize: An island country in Southeast Asia made of more than 7,600 islands
Philippines.language: Filipino and English — and many local languages on different islands
Philippines.cultureAndTraditions: Christmas season here is one of the longest in the world — starting as early as September with lanterns called parols glowing everywhere 🎄
Philippines.natureAndWildlife: Tarsiers, some of the smallest primates in the world, cling to trees with huge eyes. Volcanoes, chocolate hills, coral reefs, and white sand beaches fill the islands
Philippines.friendlyPeople: Filipinos are known for karaoke — families and friends love singing together loudly and joyfully!
